description: This file provides utility routines for root-finding of univariate functions within the Apache Commons Math library. It includes methods for solving equations, bracketing roots, verifying intervals, and ensuring bracketing conditions for a variety of solver configurations.

classes.name: UnivariateSolverUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to assist in solving univariate equations, including root bracketing and verification procedures.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Convenience method to find a zero of a univariate real function using a default solver (BrentSolver).

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Overloaded method allowing specification of absolute accuracy for the root-finding.

methods.name: forceSide
methods.description: Adjusts a root found by a non-bracketing solver to lie on a specified side, simulating bracketing behavior.

methods.name: bracket
methods.description: Attempts to find a bracketing interval around an initial guess, expanding until sign change is detected or limits are reached.

methods.name: bracket
methods.description: Overloaded variants with different control parameters, providing default or specified maximum evaluations and expansion parameters.

methods.name: midpoint
methods.description: Computes the midpoint of two values.

methods.name: isBracketing
methods.description: Checks if the function values at two points have opposite signs, indicating a root within the interval.

methods.name: isSequence
methods.description: Checks if three values form a strictly increasing sequence.

methods.name: verifyInterval
methods.description: Verifies that lower and upper bounds form a valid interval.

methods.name: verifySequence
methods.description: Verifies that the sequence low < initial < high.

methods.name: verifyBracketing
methods.description: Verifies that an interval brackets a root of the function.
